chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abū Isḥāq al-Naḥwī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about urine that affects the body. He said: “Pour water over it twice.”

key_terms.الْبَوْلِ: urine; the substance causing ritual impurity in this ruling
key_terms.الْجَسَدَ: the body; the area affected by the impurity
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: water; the purifying substance used to remove najasah
key_terms.صُبَّ: pour; the commanded method of applying water
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice; the specified number of washings required

ai.seo_question: How should the body be purified if urine gets on it according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding purification when urine comes into contact with the body. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that water should be poured over the affected area twice, indicating the method of removing this najasah.
